newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won rises on expected export negotiations.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won rises on expected export negotiations.

text.p: The won strengthened slightly by midday on Friday ahead of month-end export negotiations despite a bearish morning session, dealers said.
The won closed for the lunch break at 887.80 won, up from Thursday's closing of 888.10. It opened at the day's low of 888.10.

A dealer at SEOULBANK said most of the dollar supply had been siphoned off to cover short positions, and traders were sitting on the sidelines expecting an inflow of dollars towards the end of the month.
Dealers expected the won to hover around the 888.00 level in afternoon trading.
